1.f4 f5 2.e4 fxe4 3.Nc3.strategy: Develops with tempo by attacking the pawn on e4, so Black must spend a move defending it. This is the more ambitious way to chase the pawn: White wants quick piece play and open lines instead of a slow build-up, and accepts that the pawn is not yet won back.

1.f4 f5 2.e4 fxe4 3.Nc3 Nf6.strategy: The natural defence: the knight guards the pawn on e4, develops, and covers h5, so a queen check on that square no longer works. Black keeps the extra pawn with solid development, and White must now find a way to open lines, since quiet play only leaves Black better.
